steps.title: starter: saving the folder installs the app; its section appears in the band under the workspaces
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved starter

steps.title: sidebar-section: the focused workspace's tabs, the focused one selected
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved sidebar-section

steps.title: A new tab redraws the section
command-button: buttons for the actions in cmux-next.json
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved command-button

steps.title: The same action from the CLI: cmux action run cmuxConfig.git-status
Save-to-pixels: twelve saves of main.js, each timed to the first changed window pixels
pane: the folder now has a pane and a sidebar row that opens it
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved pane

steps.title: Open the pane: cmux action run app.open --app local/customize
